inputs.text: Create an original, exquisite botanical fine-art illustration featuring a magnolia branch. Elegant archival botanical illustration aesthetic, exceptional artistic craftsmanship, balanced vertical composition, beautiful negative space, intricate details, premium printable wall art, timeless interior decoration. Original composition, no artist signatures, no typography, no logos, no watermarks. Portrait orientation, 4:5 aspect ratio.
